name: Zero*Tsukaima ~Sanbiki no Rinkan~
original_name: ゼロ○使い魔 ～三美姫の輪姦～
source:
This is the last day of Trista*n.
It's a day where 3 girls lose their virginity.
Louise, a noble girl, Tifania, an elf girl and Henrietta, the princess of Trista*n.
Penetrate, eat, splash over their pretty body as your desire demands!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046557.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是托里○汀王国的末日。
也是三位美少女双双失去处子之身的一天。
贵族少女露易丝、精灵少女蒂法尼亚，以及托里○汀公主安丽埃塔。
顺从你心底的狂暴兽欲，肆意贯穿、吞食她们的娇躯，将滚烫的白浊尽情泼洒在她们身上吧！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046557.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
